Mountain railway Hintertuxer Gletscherbahnen

Open today
Tux/Hintertux im Zillertal

From Hintertux, the modern gondola lift runs in three sections via the Sommerbergalm and the Tuxer Fernerhaus up to 3,250 meters above sea level to the "Gefrorene Wand". On the panoramic terrace, guests can enjoy breathtaking views of the Zugspitze, Dolomites and Grossglockner. Hiking fans can choose from various mountain tours of different levels of difficulty.

We recommend because:

  • ...the ascent with the three cable cars is an experience in itself
  • ...a visit to the unique Natural Ice Palace or the Spannagel Cave will leave you in awe
  • ...a snowball fight is possible in Luis' glacier flea park in the middle of summer

Information

Season start24. Apr 2025
End of season24. May 2027

Operation times in summer

08:15 - 16:30

Information

  • wheelchair-accessible

Prices

Mountain railway tickets cost between 19 and 56 euros (adults).

Discounts

  • Children's fare: born 2011 to 2016
  • Children under the age of 10 travel free (when accompanied)
  • Group rates on request

Altitude

1,500 m - 3,250 m

Feature

This cable car has been certified with the status "Excellent Austrian Summer Cable Car" and guarantees high-quality transport into the mountains.
